source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?height ?countryLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item (MAX(?h) AS ?height) (SAMPLE(?c) AS ?country) WHERE { ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q179700 ; p:P2048/psn:P2048/wikibase:quantityAmount ?h . FILTER(?h >= 30) OPTIONAL { ?item wdt:P17 ?c } } GROUP BY ?item } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en". } } ORDER BY DESC(?sitelinks) LIMIT 82

rows.label: Statue of Liberty
rows.hook: shows a robed woman lifting a torch as a beacon of welcome to arriving immigrants

rows.label: Christ the Redeemer
rows.description: colossal statue of Jesus in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
rows.hook: shows a giant figure of a religious icon with arms spread wide overlooking a coastal city from a mountaintop

rows.label: Colossus of Rhodes
rows.description: statue of the Greek Titan Helios; one of the seven wonders of the ancient world
rows.hook: was a bronze giant of a sun god that once stood guard over a harbor entrance in the ancient world

rows.label: The Motherland Calls
rows.description: Volgograd monumental sculpture for heroes of the Battle of Stalingrad
rows.hook: shows a woman raising a sword overhead, built to honor soldiers who died defending a besieged city

rows.label: Statue of Unity
rows.description: statue of Vallabhbhai Patel at the bank of Narmada river, Gujarat, India
rows.hook: honors an independence-era leader who unified hundreds of small princely territories into one nation

rows.label: Buddhas of Bamiyan
rows.hook: were giant figures of an enlightened teacher carved into a cliffside before being destroyed by militants

rows.label: Leshan Giant Buddha
rows.hook: is carved into a cliff face overlooking the meeting point of three rivers
